rationale: 文字段落明确支持了该声明，指出Nestlé的目标是在2025年前使超过95%的塑料包装设计为可回收。具体见原文：“By 2025, we aim to design above 95% of our plastic packaging for recycling and continue to work toward 100% being recyclable or reusable Percentage of plastic packaging designed for recycling7 (%)”，以及“我们旨在到2025年使超过95%的塑料包装设计为可回收”。
flags: Support refers to stated target/design, not achieved future performance

evidence_refs.quote: We aim for >95% of our plastic packaging to be designed for recycling by 2025
